motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to approve consent items 3A through 3F with item 3A amended as indicated by changes submitted via the council Hotline and incorporating the change requested by City Attorney Gordon on item 3D.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to approve consent agenda items 3A through 3F with items 3A, 3B, and 3D as amended. The motion carried 9-0.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to recommend that the Valmont City Park Concept Plan and the development of phasing strategies move forward to site review.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to recommend that the Valmont City Park Final Concept Plan and the development of phasing strategies move forward to site review with direction to staff to develop strategies for reduced parking as outlined in the friendly amendment. The motion carried 9:0.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Wilson to introduce and order published by title only, Ordinance No. 7599 placing the question of council compensation on the November 4, 2008 ballot.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to introduce and order published by title only, Ordinance No. 7599 regarding council compensation. The motion carried 6:3; Ageton, Cowles and Morzel opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Ageton moved, seconded by Appelbaum to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7600 placing the question of allowing council to convene executive sessions on the November 4, 2008 ballot with an amendment on page 12, under Section 9: "Meetings of council," subsection (a), deleting the word "future," prior to the word "purchase."
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7600 placing the question of allowing council to convene executive sessions on the November 4, 2008 ballot with an amendment on page 12, under Section 9: "Meetings of council," subsection (a), deleting the word "future," prior to the word "purchase" and to require a two thirds vote of the quorum present to convene an executive session. The motion carried 8:1; Gray opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel NOT introduce Ordinance No. 7601 regarding requirements to include places of business on nomination petitions.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to NOT introduce Ordinance No. 7601 regarding requirements to include places of business on nomination petitions. The motion carried 9:0.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum to NOT introduce Ordinance No. 7602 regarding increasing the number of signatures required on nomination petitions.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the main motion NOT introduce Ordinance No. 7602 regarding increasing the number of signatures required on nomination petitions. The motion carried 5:4; Cowles, Espinoza, Gray and Wilson opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Osborne to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7603 regarding recall provisions.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7603 regarding recall provisions. The motion carried 9:0.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Ageton to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7604 regarding long term leases as amended to 40 years.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7604 regarding long term leases as amended to 40 years. The motion carried 9:0.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Espinoza to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7605 (option 1) regarding service on boards and commissions.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the substitute motion to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7605 (option 1) as amended in attachment G, page 35, section 130, to remove the word "electors" and replace it with the word "members," and at the end add the phrase, "and who have resided in the city of Boulder for at least one year immediately prior to appointment to serve on the commission.. The motion carried 7:2; Ageton and Morzel opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to direct staff to draft an ordinance to rezone the Orchard Grove property to Mobile Home Zone (M-HZ ) at council's next meeting on July 22.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to direct staff to initiate rezoning of the Orchard Grove property to Mobile Home Zone (MH-Z) and submitting the rezoning to the Planning Board for its August 7 meeting. The motion carried 7:2; Ageton and McGrath opposed.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Osborne to call-up the site review for 915 Pearl Street.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to call-up the site review for 915 Pearl Street. The motion carried 7:2; Cowles and Espinoza opposed.

motions.motion_text: This item was approved by acclamation.
motions.vote_text: This item was approved by acclamation.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to express to the Metro Mayors Caucus that the council does not support the resolution regarding ballot issues affecting employers and labor in Colorado.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to express to the Metro Mayors Caucus that the council does not support the resolution regarding ballot issues affecting employers and labor in Colorado. The motion failed 3:6; Ageton, Appelbaum, Espinoza, McGrath, Osborne, and Wilson opposed.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL – 6:04 p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor McGrath called the meeting to order and noted that three items were pulled from the agenda.

agenda_items.title: 2. PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE – 6:05p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard public comments and staff responses regarding Orchard Grove, Casey Middle School, Hogan Pancost, and right-of-way gardens.

agenda_items.title: 3. CONSENT AGENDA - 7:00 p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved consent items 3A through 3F with several friendly amendments.

agenda_items.title: 6. CALL- UP CHECK IN - 7:05 p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Deputy Mayor Gray discussed the site review for 915 Pearl Street.

agenda_items.title: 5. PUBLIC HEARINGS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council recommended that the Valmont City Park Final Concept Plan and phasing strategies move forward to site review.

agenda_items.title: B. INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY SEVEN ORDINANCES THAT RELATE TO POTENTIAL AMENDMENTS TO THE CHARTER OF THE CITY OF BOULDER, COLORADO. – 8:30 P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council introduced and ordered published by title only several ordinances relating to potential amendments to the City Charter.

agenda_items.title: A. Update on Tree Planting, Hazardous Tree Removal and Tree Trimming
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was removed from the agenda.

agenda_items.title: B. UPDATE ON THE USE OF THE CITY'S EDUCATION EXCISE TAX REVENUE IN PURSUIT OF LEED GOLD CERTIFICATION OF THE REBUILD OF CASEY MIDDLE SCHOOL. – 12:01 A.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard an update on LEED certification funding and recommended a broader discussion.

agenda_items.title: C. ORCHARD GROVE UPDATE – 11:14 P.M. (this item was heard prior to the Education Excise Tax item)
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council directed staff to initiate rezoning of the Orchard Grove property to Mobile Home Zone.

agenda_items.title: 7. MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY - NONE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was removed from the agenda.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: 8. MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL - 12:22 a.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council considered potential call-ups and expressed opposition to a Metro Mayors Caucus resolution.

agenda_items.title: 9. PUBLIC COMMENT ON MATTERS - 12:45 a.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard public comments regarding Orchard Grove and other local issues.

agenda_items.title: 10. FINAL DECISIONS ON MATTERS - 12:54 a.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council voted on motions regarding Orchard Grove rezoning and the 915 Pearl Street site review.

agenda_items.title: 11. ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The meeting was adjourned at 1:21 A.M.
